publisher.name: Lobbying Disclosure Act public disclosure system

dataset.name: LDA lobbyists
dataset.description: Current structured lobbyist names and registrant relationships.

acquisition.pagination: Offset pages reached through next URLs with an accepted page size of 25.
acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries, honor Retry-After on 429, and publish only a complete converged snapshot.

physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve absent, explicit null, empty string, and invalid typed values as distinct states.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Sorted observed JSON paths with JSON kinds, plus this contract version and reviewed OpenAPI overrides.

identity.occurrence_locator: snapshot digest + normalized request + page number + one-based results ordinal
identity.record_version: source-scoped id + SHA-256 of canonical record JSON
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every occurrence; conflicting content for one ID creates separate versions and blocks the current-profile projection.

rules: Preserve every structured name component and its null state.
Do not resolve a lobbyist to an external person by name alone.
Treat the nested registrant relationship as source evidence, not identity equivalence.

revisions.publisher_model: The endpoint exposes mutable current profiles rather than historical profile versions.
revisions.effective_projection: Every Legal Tender snapshot remains immutable; current display state is an explicit latest-observation projection.

checks.rule: Every normalized master record has a non-null source-scoped id.
Every results occurrence becomes a record version or an explicit issue.
Conflicting content for one ID inside one converged snapshot blocks publication.
Additive unknown fields remain captured and enter schema-drift evidence.

use.retention: Preserve complete API responses, record occurrences, source documents selected by policy, and every accepted version indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Senate Office of Public Records cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from LDA.gov.
